message.reasoning: The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or use `docker-machine start default`. But the user might want to start Docker Desktop via command line. We can instruct them to run `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` or `net start com.docker.service`. Or if they have Docker Desktop installed, they can run `& "$env:ProgramFiles\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. But the question: "start Docker on window using docker start." They might think docker start starts Docker engine. Actually docker start starts containers. So we should explain that docker start is for containers. To start Docker service, use `Start-Service com.docker.service` or `net start com.docker.service`. Provide command. Use the tool to execute? We can call the function to run the command.
